traits.terminal_bud.note: Sargent's Manual (sargent-1922, analytical key to the genera, pp. xxiii-xxiv): 'Terminal buds wanting; branchlets prolonged by an upper axillary bud' leads, with Carpinus and Ostrya, to Betula (p. 205).

traits.short_shoots.note: Hallé, Oldeman and Tomlinson 1978, pp. 59-60: Acer, Betula, Corylus, Fagus and rosaceous fruit trees such as Pyrus have a well-developed short-shoot system, whose short shoots fill most of the crown and bear most of its leaves (Wilson's red maple).
